title: An SDD Focused IDE?
summary: BMAD method creator argues spec engineering and context engineering are what BMAD's agent framework already did.

assertions.quote: learning how to use the AI agents to produce documentation and context to give to the developer agents

verdicts.note: Clear requirements, examples and references reliably improve agent output; the caveat is that bloated context can hurt, so curation matters.

assertions.quote: It's a framework of multiple agents that can help you every step of the way

verdicts.note: Owning and understanding your workflow helps you debug it, and many practitioners report framework bloat; but there is no comparative evidence, and frameworks can be a good starting point.
